name: Viscous Fingers
description: The second clip is pushed into the first like air into oil squeezed between two glass plates: a bubble grows into a few rounded fingers that keep splitting in two at their tips, shoving the old picture aside into thin glossy threads, until the fingers swell and close the last gaps. Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: center
params.description: Point where the second clip is pushed in (0..1, y down)

params.name: fingers
params.description: Number of fingers leaving the first bubble
